observations: Photo 0 shows a green and yellow handheld power tool next to a grey rectangular power unit with ventilation slots and a metal handle.
Photo 1 shows the same setup from a different angle, with the power unit on a white surface and the tool placed in front of a grey brick wall.
The tool has a yellow grip section and a green body with a black trigger and control knob.
The power unit has a black power cord with a European-style plug.
The tool has a chuck at the end, consistent with a drill or router.
No visible brand or model name is readable on either the tool or the power unit in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Tokunbo Proxxon Hand Drilling and router' and 'Fully working'.

claims.claim: Tokunbo Proxxon Hand Drilling and router
claims.evidence: No brand or model is visible on the tool or power unit in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.
No video or photo shows the tool in operation. No power test or functionality proof is provided.

claims.claim: Recently serviced by the dealer, all parts complete. Original from the manufacturer.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tool may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the tool turning on, rotating, and cutting through material.

risks.risk: The power unit may be non-functional or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the power unit powering the tool and the tool operating under load.

risks.risk: The tool may be missing parts or accessories (e.g., chuck, key, adapter).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included components laid out.

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the power unit showing the model and voltage.
Video of the tool operating under load.
Photo showing all included accessories and parts.
Clear photo of any brand or model label on the tool or power unit.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
